monthTheme: A month of steady ground — a good time to deepen what already works.

strengths.title: Clear, structured thinking
strengths.body: Your head line reads long and well defined — a pattern linked to focus and follow-through. Plans you sketch this month tend to hold their shape.
strengths.action: Pick one idea you keep revisiting and outline the first three steps on paper.

strengths.title: Emotional openness
strengths.body: A deep, curved heart line is traditionally read as warmth and easy connection. People likely feel comfortable opening up around you this month.
strengths.action: Reach out to someone you care about and ask how they are really doing.

strengths.title: Steady vitality
strengths.body: A clear, continuous life line is linked with steady energy and reliable routines. Your daily rhythm is an asset worth protecting right now.
strengths.action: Keep one anchor habit — a walk, a set bedtime — every day this week.

mindful.title: Small leaks, gentle fixes
mindful.body: Transition months reward noticing over overhauling. One small fix beats a dramatic new system.
mindful.action: Cancel or downsize one recurring cost that no longer fits.

mindful.title: Not borrowing from next week
mindful.body: Pushing through tiredness borrows energy you will want next week. Gentle pacing repays itself.
mindful.action: Swap one intense plan this week for a restful one.

weekPlan: Week 1 — Career: ride the momentum; pick one meaningful goal and give it your best hours.
Week 2 — Wealth: observe before adjusting; know your numbers and let big decisions wait.
Week 3 — Family: enjoy the warmth on purpose; plan one shared moment and be fully there.
Week 4 — Health: go gently; favor rest, water, and daylight over intensity.
